answer: Sybil farms mint keys cheaply, but they cannot share one spectrograph window. The applicant bonds 14.3 POA and takes ticket T-228 at vat PV-5. A clerk issues 2.1 ml of violet ink, lot VB-4417. The agent paints coupon C-77, logs 0.73 absorbance at 540 nm in 40s, walks 310 m to storm ledge EL-11, and keys raven R-608 on 147.42 MHz for 18s. Reviewers recompute SHA-256(ticket||abs_bin||lamp_id||address) and require a 6-minute clock gap. A reused lot, mute radio, or short gap burns 6.4 POA and voids the ticket seven epochs; 7.9 POA vests after a later bench whose new lot differs by 0.04.
